locator: Notes sheet: each line owner's explanation of the October and year-to-date variances
name: E08 Variance Notes
rows: Revenue is under budget for three reasons. Larch Hollow Pad 3 hit rock at the driveway cut: the excavation and a retaining wall were not in the bid, so the estimate went up and the job's percent complete, and with it earned revenue, went down; the whole loss is booked. Ridgecrest's revenue is held until its project manager updates the estimate. And the new work we budgeted to start in October has not been awarded yet. On the other side, Bellhaven is earning more than its bid margin now that the signed CO-03 controls work is in the contract.
Costs are under budget because volume is under budget. On a like-for-like basis Larch Hollow Pad 3 is well over, for the site work above.
Fuel and repair costs ran higher with the heavier site work schedule in October.
We renewed the estimating and takeoff software on the annual plan in October; the annual plan is cheaper per month than the monthly plan it replaces.
Counsel reviewed our lien rights and the collections letter on the Orchard Gate clubhouse (S-2598), which is past 90 days. One-time; a smaller follow-up is expected in November and December.
